summary: Iteration 161 - iPad Login Tests VERIFIED. All features confirmed: (1) Händler-Login on iPad viewport via /login with haendler@bidblitz.ae / Haendler2026! works correctly, (2) Mitarbeiter-Login on iPad viewport via /staff/mobile with mitarbeiter@bidblitz.ae + PIN 1234 works correctly and lands on Staff Dashboard, (3) Staff PIN API POST /api/staff/auth/terminal-pin sets session cookie correctly, (4) GET /api/staff/auth/me works after PIN login, (5) No regression on normal .ae admin/merchant login.

ipad_haendler_login.details: Login on iPad viewport (768x1024) via /login with haendler@bidblitz.ae / Haendler2026! works correctly. User 'Lisa Schmidt' lands on authenticated home page with balance EUR 2,561.59 visible.

ipad_mitarbeiter_pin_login.details: Login on iPad viewport (768x1024) via /staff/mobile with mitarbeiter@bidblitz.ae + PIN 1234 works correctly. Shows 'Erfolgreich angemeldet' toast and lands on Staff Dashboard with 'Schicht starten' button, time tracking cards, and bottom navigation.

staff_pin_api.details: POST /api/staff/auth/terminal-pin correctly authenticates staff with identifier + PIN, sets staff_session cookie, and returns member info.

staff_auth_me_api.details: GET /api/staff/auth/me works correctly after PIN login, returning staff profile with id, name, email, role.

ae_login_regression.details: Normal .ae domain login for admin@bidblitz.ae and haendler@bidblitz.ae works correctly with no regression.

POST /api/staff/auth/terminal-pin.returns: { success: true, member: { id, name, email, role } }

GET /api/staff/auth/me.returns: { success: true, staff: { id, name, email, role, ... } }

critical_code_review_comments: StaffMobilePage.jsx correctly uses POST /api/staff/auth/terminal-pin for PIN login
Backend staff.py terminal-pin endpoint correctly sets staff_session cookie with httpOnly
Email alias handling (.ae/.com) works correctly in both auth.py and staff.py
Demo fallback PIN 1234 works for testing purposes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 161 verified iPad login for both Händler (/login) and Mitarbeiter (/staff/mobile with PIN). Key findings: (1) Staff PIN login via /api/staff/auth/terminal-pin works with identifier + PIN, sets staff_session cookie, (2) /api/staff/auth/me works after PIN login, (3) StaffMobilePage shows login form with Magic Link and PIN options, (4) After successful PIN login, Staff Dashboard shows 'Erfolgreich angemeldet' toast, time tracking, and bottom navigation. All data-testids verified: staff-mobile-login, staff-mobile-identifier-input, staff-mobile-pin-toggle, staff-mobile-pin-input, staff-mobile-pin-login-btn, staff-mobile-page.
